_description: Pre-assessed functional levels for SRI services without real-time CSV sensor data. All levels based on documentary evidence (DBL09, DBL08, IFC inventory). Edit this file to update any level without touching the main engine.

H-1b.justification: DBL09: Radiant floor heating on ground floor (GF), controlled by INNOVA eHPoca 3in1 HP controller -- zone-level on/off based on supply water setpoint. IFC: 8 IFCSPACEHEATER elements consistent with combined radiant panels and radiators. No dedicated radiant-floor CSV available to verify scheduling (L2) or optimization (L3). Conservative: L1.

H-1c.justification: DBL09: INNOVA eHPoca 3in1 air-to-water HP with integrated controller manages distribution supply temperature. L1 (variable temperature setpoint) confirmed by HP controller presence. L2 (weather-compensated) is technically probable for this HP model but no data log of supply temperature vs outdoor temperature available in CSV to verify. Conservative: L1.

H-1d.justification: DBL09: Distribution circuit with radiant floor and radiators implies circulation pump(s). INNOVA HP system includes pump management. IFC: 1866 pipe segments confirm distribution network. No pump speed/status CSV available. L1 (time-based on/off) is minimum guaranteed; L2+ cannot be verified without pump data logs. Conservative: L1.

H-2a.justification: DBL09: IMMERGAS HERCULES SOLAR 25 is a condensing gas boiler with integrated modulating burner and dedicated controller. Condensing boilers inherently modulate -- L1 (modulating control) verified. L2 (demand-based optimised start/stop) requires documented automatic optimisation logic, not evidenced in available sources. Conservative: L1.

H-2b.justification: DBL09: INNOVA eHPoca 3in1 is an inverter air-to-water heat pump. Inverter drive provides continuous capacity modulation (0-100%) -- L2 verified. L3 (demand-based with grid signals) requires documented grid interaction capability, not evidenced in CSV or DBL. Conservative: L2.

H-2d.justification: DBL09: Hybrid system with INNOVA eHPoca 3in1 HP (primary) and IMMERGAS condensing boiler (backup/peak). HP leads at mild temperatures; boiler activates for peak load or backup -- this is automatic energy-based sequencing, L2. L3 (weather/grid signal integration) and L4 (predictive) not evidenced. Conservative: L2.

DHW-1a.justification: DBL09: INNOVA eHPoca 3in1 includes DHW production mode (3-in-1 = space heating + cooling + DHW). HP charges the 200L IMMERGAS storage tank. L1 (timed on/off for HP DHW charge) confirmed by HP controller presence. L2 (demand-based) and L3 (predictive) not evidenced -- no DHW HP mode CSV available. Conservative: L1.

DHW-1b.justification: DBL09: IMMERGAS HERCULES SOLAR 25 condensing boiler with integrated DHW function and 200L storage. Dedicated boiler controller manages DHW charging program -- L1 (timed DHW charge). L2 (demand-adaptive) and L3 (predictive) not evidenced in CSV or DBL. Conservative: L1.

DHW-2b.justification: DBL09: Three DHW generators present -- INNOVA HP (3in1), IMMERGAS condensing boiler, and solar thermal CP4 XL. Solar differential controller automatically prioritises solar, then HP, then boiler based on available solar energy and storage temperature. This is automatic energy-optimal sequencing, L2. L3 (grid signal) and L4 (predictive) not evidenced. Conservative: L2.

L-1a.justification: DBL09 and DBL08: No automated lighting control documented. No lighting CSV found. IFC Architectural: no IfcLightFixture or lighting controller elements. Standard manual switches assumed -- L0.

L-2.justification: DBL09 and DBL08: No daylight sensor or automated daylight-responsive lighting documented. No illuminance sensor in DBL08 sensing section (N/A). No lighting CSV. IFC Architectural: no automated shading or lighting control elements -- L0.

E-3.justification: DBL09: Battery storage system with BMS (Battery Management System) documented. Battery charges from PV during daylight -- L1 (basic charge/discharge). L2 (self-consumption optimisation) is typical BMS function but not verifiable without battery SOC CSV (no Shelly or BMS CSV available). Conservative: L1.

E-4.justification: DBL09: BMS and battery storage system. BMS inherently prioritises self-consumption (PV then loads then battery then grid) -- L1. L2 (time-based optimisation, e.g. TOU tariff) possible but not evidenced in any CSV or DBL. Conservative: L1.

E-8.justification: DBL09: Battery storage and BMS and PV 2.4 kWp. Technical capability for islanding exists (battery + inverter). However: no documentation of micro-grid or islanding mode in DBL; no CSV showing grid disconnection events; no inverter specs confirming grid-forming capability. Classified UNRESOLVED -- lower bound L0, upper bound L1.

E-11.justification: DBL09: Battery storage system with BMS. BMS typically provides SOC display and logging -- L1 (basic reading). No battery SOC CSV available (Shelly not accessible). L2 and above (historical SOC trends, performance analysis) cannot be verified. Conservative: L1.

MC-25.justification: DBL09: BMS and battery and PV present -- technical basis for smart grid integration exists. No CSV or DBL documentation of TOU tariff-based control, grid signal response, or demand-response programme. Classified UNRESOLVED. Lower bound: L0; upper bound: L1.

MC-28.justification: No DSM (demand-side management) programme documented in DBL or CSV. MC-25 (smart grid integration) is also UNRESOLVED, making DSM reporting contingent on its resolution. Lower bound: L0; upper bound: L1.
